Getting Started

Upload a PDF

Click the upload button in the center of the canvas, or drag a PDF file onto the page to load floor plans. Only PDF files are accepted.

Page Selection

After uploading, a page picker appears with thumbnails of every PDF page. Check the pages you want to include and click Confirm. Use Select All or Deselect All for quick bulk selection.

Navigating Pages

  • Use the ‹ and › buttons in the toolbar to move between pages
  • The page indicator shows Page X / Y (with [flipped] appended when the page is mirrored)
  • Each page stores its own stamps independently
Tip: To close the current plan and start a new one, click ✕ Exit in the header. You will be prompted to save any unsaved changes first.

Activating Placement Mode

In the left sidebar under Standard Fixtures, find the fixture you want and click its + button. The row turns green and the cursor becomes a crosshair — you are now in placement mode.

Placing Stamps

  • Click anywhere on the floor plan to drop a stamp at that location
  • Continue clicking to place multiple stamps without re-clicking the + button
  • Press Space or Esc to exit placement mode

Snap Guides

While in placement mode, yellow dashed alignment guides appear when your cursor hovers near an existing stamp. The cursor auto-snaps to align with it when within 40 pixels.

Stamp Size

The Size input in the toolbar sets the diameter of all stamps on the current page (range 8–80 px, default 24). Adjustments apply immediately to all existing stamps on that page.

Tip: Fixture counts in the sidebar reflect the current page only. A dash (—) means zero stamps of that type on this page.

Create a Custom Fixture

Click + Add Custom at the top of the sidebar. Fill in the dialog:

  • Name — up to 20 characters (e.g., "Step Light")
  • Letter — 1–2 character code shown on the stamp (auto-filled from name)
  • Shape — Circle, Square, Diamond, Triangle, Plus, Hexagon, or Rounded Rect
  • Color — 11 preset swatches or full custom color picker

Click Add to save the fixture and immediately enter placement mode for it.

Add from Catalog

Click Catalog to browse manufacturer SKUs organized by category. Use the search box to filter by name, SKU code, or finish. Select a SKU, assign a shape and color, then click Add & Place. If that fixture already exists it will be reused without creating a duplicate.

Deleting Custom Fixtures

Click the × button on any custom fixture row to remove it. All stamps of that fixture are removed from every page.

Single Selection

Click any stamp to select it. A glow effect indicates it is selected.

Multi-Selection

  • Shift + Click — toggles a stamp in or out of the current selection
  • Lasso — click and drag on an empty part of the canvas to draw a freeform selection polygon. Release to select all stamps inside it.

Moving Stamps

Click and drag any selected stamp to reposition it. If multiple stamps are selected, all move together. Stamps are constrained to the canvas boundary.

Clearing Selection

  • Press Esc to deselect everything
  • Click any empty area of the canvas to deselect
Tip: After a lasso selection you can immediately drag to move all selected stamps without clicking again.

Copy & Paste

  • Ctrl+C or the toolbar Copy button — copies all selected stamps
  • Ctrl+V or the toolbar Paste button — pastes at the original positions. The button label shows the clipboard count.
  • Copy on one page, navigate to another page, then paste to duplicate a fixture arrangement across pages

Delete

Press Delete or Backspace, or click the ✕ Delete toolbar button to remove all selected stamps.

Undo / Redo

  • Ctrl+Z — undo the last action (placement, move, or delete)
  • Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z — redo
  • Undo history is per session and resets when a new PDF is loaded

Enabling Zones Mode

Click the ⊟ Zones button in the toolbar. It highlights blue and the cursor changes to a column-resize icon.

Placing & Moving Dividers

  • Click anywhere on the plan to place a vertical orange divider line
  • Click near an existing divider and drag horizontally to reposition it
  • Drag a divider all the way to the left or right edge to remove it

Renaming Zones

Each zone shows a label above its divider. Click the ✎ pencil icon next to a label to rename the zone (e.g., "Unit 101", "Master Bed").

Per-Page Dividers

Dividers can be positioned independently per page. When you drag a divider on a specific page, that page stores its own positions separate from the global layout.

Effect on Exported PDF

Stamps are automatically detected in whichever zone they are physically located — you do not need to manually assign a stamp to a zone. When zones are defined, the exported PDF generates separate legend sections per zone, each showing only the fixtures within that zone and their counts.

Page Navigation

  • Click ‹ / › in the toolbar to step through pages
  • The page indicator shows the current page, total pages, original PDF page number, and whether the page is flipped

Zoom

  • Ctrl++ / Ctrl+− or the + / − toolbar buttons — zoom in or out in 20% steps (range 20%–500%)
  • Ctrl+0 — reset zoom to 100%
  • Ctrl+Scroll — zoom centered on the cursor position

Panning

  • Hold the right mouse button and drag to pan

Flip Page

Click ⇄ Flip to mirror the current page horizontally. Useful when plans are drawn as mirror images. The page indicator shows [flipped] when active. Stamps and dividers all respect the flipped state.

Saving a Layout

  • Save As — opens a dialog to name the layout and choose whether it is a Plan or a Job. If the name already exists you will be prompted to replace it.
  • Save — overwrites the currently open named layout. Only available after the layout has been saved at least once with Save As.

All stamp positions, electrical specs, zones, page selections, custom fixtures, flip states, and the PDF file are stored in the cloud and tied to your account.

Plans vs. Jobs

When saving, choose the layout type:

  • Plan — a standard floor plan template (shown in the Saved Layouts list in the sidebar)
  • Job — a job-specific layout with custom stamp selections (shown in the separate Jobs list, accessible via the Jobs button next to Saved Layouts)

Electrical Specs (A / B / C)

Each layout supports three independent electrical spec variants — A, B, and C. Toggle between them using the Spec A, Spec B, and Spec C buttons in the header toolbar.

  • Switching specs saves the current spec's stamps and loads the selected spec's stamps — all other layout data (zones, pages, custom fixtures) is shared
  • Undo history resets each time you switch specs
  • The active spec is appended to the export filename (e.g., Hadley A KL — Spec B)
  • Specs are saved together in a single layout — no need to maintain three separate files

Layout Manager

  • All saved layouts are listed at the bottom of the sidebar; use the search box to filter by name
  • Click a layout name to open it
  • The ⋯ menu on each layout row offers: Rename, Duplicate, Delete
  • The active layout is highlighted in blue

Exporting to PDF

Click ⬆ Export PDF in the toolbar. Enter an output filename when prompted. The exported file contains:

  • Legend pages — each fixture type with its count; one legend per zone if zones are defined
  • Floor plan pages — original PDF pages with stamps, dividers, and zone labels rendered on top
Tip: Export is available any time a PDF is loaded — you do not need to save the layout first.
